content: Runtime integration without permanent fork: (1) GGML_BACKEND_DL dynamic backend loading (PR #10469) builds backends as shared libs loaded at runtime via ggml_backend_load_all - plugin mechanism exists but overriding single ops of the built-in HIP backend still requires modifying that backend; (2) patch-overlay/quilt: mesh-llm keeps pinned upstream SHA + small ordered commit series documented per-area; qvac merging_strategy uses temp-upstream/temp-latest branches; ik_llama.cpp proves long-lived custom-kernel fork viable but heavy maintenance (eventually moved hosts); recommended hybrid: vendored upstream pinned commit + quilt patch series producing baseline and custom builds from same tree behind compile flags.
